statusMeaning.MATCHED: before and after both exist, depict the same surface and the same measured theme; a genuine comparison
statusMeaning.AFTER-ONLY: a post-redesign frame exists but no historical before frame does; an after-only observation, never a matched comparison
statusMeaning.THEME-MISMATCHED: both frames exist but their measured themes differ, so pairing them would misrepresent the change
statusMeaning.BEFORE-ONLY: a historical before frame exists with no post-redesign counterpart
statusMeaning.BEFORE-SURFACE-DIFFERS: the only historical frame is a different surface (e.g. a workout-leg result), so it is not a pair
